name: Little Fern
source:
You play as a victim of abuse who wants to work toward their dreams but can't get out of their situation. One day you take a trip to the nearby gas station and meet someone who may be able to help you out.

[From [url=https://ccloverstudios.itch.io/little-fern-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个虐待的受害者，他想为自己的梦想而努力，但无法摆脱困境。有一天，你去附近的加油站，遇到了一个可能可以帮助你的人。

[来自[url=https://ccloverstudios.itch.io/little-fern-vn]itch.io[/url]]
